requirements.title: A FLUSH spec list specifies a unit and positional units are first
requirements.definition: A file-unit-number shall be specified in a flush-spec-list; if UNIT= is omitted from the unit specifier, the file-unit-number shall be the first item.

pending.flush-file-unit-present: Diagnostic/control pair compares `FLUSH (IOSTAT=ios)` with `FLUSH (UNIT=u, IOSTAT=ios)`; the only repair supplies the missing unit.
pending.flush-positional-unit-first: Diagnostic/control pair compares `FLUSH (IOSTAT=ios, u)` with `FLUSH (IOSTAT=ios, UNIT=u)`; the invalid form has a unit but omits UNIT= outside first position.

requirements.definition: The label in an ERR= specifier shall be the statement label of a branch target statement in the same inclusive scope as the FLUSH statement.
